name: Haltline
tagline: Your daily loss limit, at a glance
description: Haltline shows how close you are to your own daily loss limit on your glasses, and lets you cut or dismiss with one confirmed gesture. Paper trading only: a simulated account priced from public market data. Not financial advice. No real funds. Tested in the official Even Hub simulator; not yet verified on physical glasses (swipe direction mapping and BLE update timing are hardware-unverified).

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Reads your paper account and sends confirmed paper actions to the Haltline backend.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Listens only while you ask it to, to hear a spoken daily limit such as "set limit five hundred". The recording is sent to the Haltline backend for transcription; Haltline does not store it.
